defect: Repair acceptance silently skipped missing terms and null margins, while its term map overwrote duplicates. Frozen migration fixtures explicitly expected five examples of lost or ambiguous evidence to be accepted.
reproduction: An independent test removed the only enforced term from an otherwise passing rebuilt ledger. Before the fix, the test failed because accept_compose_repair returned success (native/build/compose-evidence-before-test.log).
changes: Reject missing/malformed term arrays and duplicate identities in either ledger.
Require every original term and requested target to remain present; reject lost enforcement.
Require finite numeric rebuilt measured/bound/margin evidence for enforced or targeted terms.
Reject invalid numeric margins without proceeding into unsafe scalar comparisons. An initial NaN adversarial test exposed that diagnostic path and was fixed.
Keep the full board gate pipeline, original margin policy, repair thresholds, operation accounting and rollback authority unchanged.

verification.historical_expectation_changes: Only the five documented missing/null/duplicate unsafe acceptance examples now require explicit rejection; other frozen acceptance cases retain their expected verdicts and reasons.
verification.workflow: Existing successful native rebuild, gate rejection, failed build, exception rollback, concurrent edit preservation and exact measurement-accounting tests pass.

limits: This is a repair acceptance reliability correction, not a placement improvement, a full board requalification, a complete ledger-schema validator or a performance benchmark. Full hardware qualification and the wider goal remain incomplete.
